connector.name: DeepThonk
connector.registryDescription: Provider-neutral OpenDeepThink reasoning server: generate, judge, rank, mutate.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package deepthonk. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the linxule account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the DeepSeek provider. Optional: omit to use MCP sampling or another provider.

env.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
env.description: API key for the OpenRouter provider. Optional: omit to use MCP sampling or another provider.

env.name: DEEPTHONK_API_KEY
env.description: API key for a custom openai-compatible provider endpoint. Optional.

env.name: DEEPTHONK_PROFILES_DIR
env.description: Directory of custom profile YAML files. Defaults to the config directory's profiles/.
